# Third-party preview component

`model-viewer-4.3.1.min.js` is the pinned distribution of `@google/model-viewer` 4.3.1, provided under Apache-2.0. The accompanying licence text is preserved. Its npm tarball was checked against its published SHA-512 integrity value before extraction. See https://modelviewer.dev/ and https://github.com/google/model-viewer.

The unmodified bundle also includes Lit (BSD-3-Clause), Three.js (MIT) and fflate (MIT). Its inline notices are retained and accompanying dependency licence texts are in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.
